title: View live hardware cockpit status
description: Verify that opening the cockpit shows the live battery and hardware state with the core KPI strip populated.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the live state of charge gauge and core capacity metrics are displayed
Verify active power flow, cycle counters, and ACPI status are displayed

title: Export and restore telemetry archive
description: Verify that the telemetry archive can be exported and then imported back to restore the historical archive state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Export the telemetry archive
Import the exported telemetry archive
Verify the historical archive state is restored
Verify the cockpit and historical analysis remain available after restore

title: Read live charging and drain flow states
description: Verify that the cockpit reflects the current wattage flow state for charge, standby, or drain.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the active wattage flow state is displayed
Verify the live cockpit context remains visible

title: Inspect chart values with crosshair and reset zoom
description: Verify that scrubbing the historical chart shows instantaneous values and that zoom can be returned to the full view.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the historical telemetry chart view
Scrub across the chart to inspect values
Reset the chart zoom
Verify floating tooltip values are displayed during inspection
Verify the chart returns to the full historical view after zoom reset

title: Import a valid telemetry archive and restore history
description: This verifies that a user can import a saved telemetry archive and see the historical archive state restored in the cockpit.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to import a telemetry archive
Select a valid telemetry archive file
Verify the historical archive state is restored
Verify historical telemetry content is displayed

title: Change telemetry channel and preset range
description: Verify that a user can switch the historical telemetry channel and preset time range and see the analysis view update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the telemetry channel selector
Select a different telemetry channel
Open the date range selector
Select a preset time range
Verify the chart updates to the selected telemetry channel and time window
Verify the KPI context remains synchronized with the selected window

title: Export the complete telemetry archive
description: This verifies that a user can export the full telemetry archive from the cockpit and receive a downloadable JSON archive.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to export the telemetry archive
Verify a telemetry archive download is initiated
Verify the archive export remains available on the cockpit

title: Toggle historical series visibility
description: Verify that the historical chart can show and hide telemetry series pills without losing chart coherence.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the historical telemetry chart view
Toggle the power series
Toggle the voltage series
Toggle the state of charge series
Toggle the temperature series
Toggle the health series
Verify the chart remains visible with the selected series displayed
Verify the series selection state is reflected in the chart

title: Inspect Coulomb cycle precision in the cockpit
description: Verify that the cockpit exposes high-precision Coulomb integration and cycle counters for engineering review.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify Coulomb accumulated cycle counters are displayed
Verify high-precision integration values are displayed

title: Cycle through all preset history ranges
description: Verify that the preset range selector supports the common engineering review windows from short-term to lifetime history.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the date range selector
Select a 5 minute preset range
Open the date range selector
Select a 1 hour preset range
Open the date range selector
Select a 24 hour preset range
Open the date range selector
Select a 7 day preset range
Open the date range selector
Select a 30 day preset range
Open the date range selector
Select a year-to-date preset range
Open the date range selector
Select a lifetime preset range
Verify the selected preset range updates the analysis window

title: Export before importing to preserve archive availability
description: This verifies that export remains usable even after a user performs an import workflow on the same page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to export the telemetry archive
Click the control to import a telemetry archive
Select a valid telemetry archive file
Click the control to export the telemetry archive again
Verify a telemetry archive download is initiated
Verify the cockpit remains synchronized after the import

title: Enable smoothing for monotonic historical curves
description: Verify that turning on smoothing preserves a readable historical trend in the SVG chart for engineering review.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the historical telemetry chart view
Toggle curve smoothing
Verify the smoothed historical chart is displayed
Verify the trend remains monotonic without visual retrograde behavior

title: Importing a valid archive updates the cockpit history context
description: This verifies that importing a telemetry archive updates the historical context used by the cockpit for analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to import a telemetry archive
Select a valid telemetry archive file
Verify the chart history context is restored
Verify the cockpit reflects the imported telemetry archive

title: Review ACPI offline charging audit state
description: Verify that the cockpit surfaces the ACPI offline charging audit state needed for hardware validation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the ACPI hardware status is displayed
Verify the offline charging audit ledger state is displayed

title: Select a custom calendar range for analysis
description: Verify that selecting a custom calendar date range updates the chart and analysis context to the chosen telemetry window.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the date range selector
Select a custom calendar date range
Verify the chart updates to the selected custom time window
Verify the selected time window is reflected in the analysis context

title: Restore a saved archive after clearing the current archive view
description: This verifies that importing a valid archive brings historical telemetry back into view when the current archive view is empty or changed.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the control to import a telemetry archive
Select a valid telemetry archive file
Verify the historical archive state is restored
Verify the restored archive contains historical telemetry data

title: Export and import remain available from the main cockpit page
description: This verifies that the main cockpit page exposes both archive actions without requiring navigation away from the live telemetry view.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify export archive controls are available
Verify import archive controls are available
